authority: User explicitly approved Jena P branch 20 runs and presentation revision; no additional commit/push requested.

methods.P_TIME_ONLY: Retain the original temporal LayerNorm + temporal residual MLP; remove the feature branch.
methods.P_CHANNEL_ONLY: Retain the original feature LayerNorm + feature residual MLP; remove the temporal branch.

normalization: Original joint LayerNorm over L x C is retained. These are branch ablations, not end-to-end axis independence.
initialization: Construct the original full model with the original seed; retain the corresponding original branch without new random initialization. Common E/D PCA initialization and data-order rules remain unchanged.
backbone: Frozen Chronos-Bolt-small; original state SHA and checkpoint; FP32; L512 H48.

training.selection: Minimum A_stop MSE; earlier epoch on exact tie; selection sealed before fresh A60 refit and V evaluation.

data_bounds.loader: Unchanged safe Jena pre-T prefix loader

extension_policy.trigger: At least 5 of the 10 base seeds choose cap 3.
extension_policy.action: Whole family 10 seeds freshly searched/refit to cap10 only if deadline budget permits.
extension_policy.incomplete: Retain base result as provisional; never mix partial extension seeds into the primary result.
extension_policy.terminal: If at least 5/10 choose cap10 mark UNDERTRAINED_AT_10; no further extension.
extension_policy.decision_data: A_stop selected epochs and elapsed time only; never V metric values.

controller_policy.retry: Same job/scientific settings for recoverable execution failure only; completed verified jobs reused.

primary_contrasts: OURS vs P_TIME_ONLY: incremental feature-branch contribution in current architecture.
OURS vs P_CHANNEL_ONLY: incremental temporal-branch contribution in current architecture.
analysis.decision: Descriptive original median/max-IQR rule only; no statistical significance or equivalence claims.
interpretive_limits: Unequal branch capacities: direct time-only/channel-only contrast does not isolate axis superiority.
A2 is additional context, not a complete capacity/FLOP control.
Jena was chosen after observing the existing P effect; all new V results are exploratory.
No generalization claim to other datasets or protected T.
All base and extended results remain available; extension replaces base only as a complete 10-seed family.

deliverables: revised local PPTX/PDF presentation and notes
